name: Choir Drone
desc: A silver scout of the machine fleet. It hums in harmony.

intro: A silver drone drifts into view, humming a note you can feel in your teeth.
hit: A lance of silver light goes through you, and the humming climbs.
It strikes, and for an instant you hear voices you know.
miss: The lance of light cuts through the bulkhead where you stood.
It adjusts its pitch, as if listening, and fires wide.
crit: The note rises until you can't think, and then the light finds you.
defeated: The humming falls silent, and the drone drops, ringing, to the deck.
